subject: All users report servers down
body: Every team at Facility N2 receives a servers down message in the portal. Nobody can log in and all dock operations have stopped.

subject: Wrong trailer sent at dock 11G
body: At dock 11G the handheld sends the wrong trailer when an operator requests a container. We stopped this dock because the move could be incorrect.

subject: Request-In error at AS04
body: The Request-In action at door AS04 throws an error on two unit numbers. Other doors are working; can you investigate?

subject: New coordinator account
body: Please create a new user with dock coordinator access at Facility N2 next week. Manager approval can be provided.

subject: Production line stopped—no handheld dispatch
body: Our production line is stopped. Drivers do not receive any dispatches on their handheld devices. Need immediate help.

subject: Repeated trailers in departure report
body: Our departure report lists the same trailers twice but we can still dispatch them. Please check report filtering.

subject: Pending uploads on one device
body: Device H-13 shows eight pending uploads. Only this handheld is affected; please help sync safely.

subject: Add a dock door to configuration
body: Can we add dock door 53 to the system for next month? Please assign it to our approved dispatch group.

subject: Offsite trailer status prevents return
body: Offsite trailers appear already inbound and cannot be brought into the pool. Today's production shift is blocked from using them.

subject: One trailer detail fails to open
body: A server error occurs on just one trailer record, but other records open and there is no general outage.

subject: All doors unable to dispatch
body: None of our driver handhelds receive dispatch moves anywhere at Facility N2. Every dock is affected and operations are completely shut down.

subject: Report export instructions
body: Could someone show our supervisor how to export the monthly trailer inventory report? There is no technical problem.
